ItemId.description: Optional identifier of the connection. When it matches a stored connection, that connection is updated; otherwise the connection is matched by Name. A new connection keeps this identifier when it is up to 26 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, and gets a generated one otherwise.

Name.description: Technical name of the connection: a letter, then letters, digits and underscores. A connection without a matching ItemId is matched by this name. Made from DisplayText when omitted.

DisplayText.description: Name of the connection shown in the admin UI.

Connector.description: The connector the connection uses. Its feature must be enabled. An existing connection's connector can't change.

Server.description: The server name or address, with an optional instance or port.

Authentication.description: How the site signs in, by name or by position from 0: SqlLogin, Integrated, EntraServicePrincipal, EntraManagedIdentity or EntraDefault. SqlLogin and EntraServicePrincipal take their password or client secret from the 'Password' secret.

UserName.description: The login name, the client id of a service principal, or the client id of a user-assigned managed identity.

TrustServerCertificate.description: Whether the server's certificate is trusted without validation.

ReadOnlyIntent.description: Whether the connection declares read-only intent, so it can be routed to a readable secondary.

ConnectTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a connection.

SqlServerConnectionSettings.description: The settings of a SqlServer connection.

BaseUrl.description: The base address the data sets' paths are resolved against.

Authentication.description: How requests authenticate. Its secrets (such as Password, ApiKey, BearerToken or ClientSecret) travel in Secrets.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a response.

HttpConnectionSettings.description: The settings of an HttpApi connection.

MediaFilesConnectionSettings.description: The settings of a MediaFiles connection.

ElasticsearchDataConnectionSettings.description: The settings of an Elasticsearch connection.

Properties.description: The connector's settings, keyed by the name of their type, as a deployment plan exports them. Each settings object given replaces the stored one; settings not given are kept. Enumerations travel as their names.

Secrets.description: The connection's secrets in clear text, keyed by name (for example Password, ApiKey, BearerToken or ClientSecret). They are encrypted when stored. A deployment plan never exports them; an empty or missing secret keeps the one already stored.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

ModifiedUtc.description: Optional last-modified timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the connection.

Connections.description: The data connections to create or update.
